title: Synchronous launch checklist for model addition: catalog, benchmarks, docs, and comms
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Purpose: Orchestrate a synchronous, low-risk launch for adding a new model variant to the Redwood model catalog. This ticket consolidates the cross-team checklist, acceptance criteria, and comms timeline for catalog entry, benchmark publication, docs updates, release notes, and downstream alerts. Goal: ship catalog entry + public benchmark page + SDK docs + release notes with an observability baseline and a defined rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Catalog entry visible in staging and production with correct metadata and pricing tier. 2) Benchmark page published with raw numbers and methodology. 3) SDK examples updated and smoke-tested in two runtimes (hosted + dedicated). 4) Release notes drafted and approved by PM, Eng lead, and Legal. 5) Monitoring dashboards and alerting rules created and validated with synthetic traffic. 6) All launch comms scheduled in the marketing calendar.
checklist: Product: finalize model metadata (name, tags, recommended use cases, pricing tier, deprecation policy)
Engineering: staging catalog integration + migration test (schema compatibility and model fingerprints)
Benchmarks: run perf suite for p50/p95 latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens, quality evals on canonical prompt set
Quality: quality regressions check (automatic and manual eval on representative prompts)
SDKs/docs: update SDK examples (Python, Node), add quickstart and sample prompts, API contract bump notes
Console: add per-model dashboard tile, default alert thresholds, token cost breakdown view
Release notes: draft release note blurb, include known limitations and recommended model fallback mapping
Marketing: pre-announce demo material drafted, customer-facing blog post outline, launch email copy
Legal/Compliance: export control & model license confirmation for public catalog availability
Sales/Customer Success: one-pager with TL;DR, pricing guidance, and known limitations
Support: shared runbook for common issues and escalation path (Slack channel + on-call rota)
Telemetry: add event for model_selected and model_version_rollout with tags for variant and deployment mode
Rollout: define canary percentage, duration, and kill-switch criteria; automated fallback to baseline model on error rate spike
Post-launch: schedule 72-hour and 30-day quality review, collect feedback from top 5 power users
communications_timeline: T-7 days: internal launch prez to Eng/Support/Sales/Marketing (recording in Confluence)
T-3 days: send detailed launch notes to beta customers and selected partners
Launch day T0: publish catalog entry, benchmark page, SDK docs; push release notes; marketing email and blog post go live
T+1 day: Monitoring check-in, escalate any alerts, publish first-day usage snapshot to execs
T+7 days: Digest of early usage, bugfixes, and quality signal to stakeholders
runbooks_and_playbooks: Rollback playbook: immediate dual-write disable + route traffic to model-stable v2; steps and PRs referenced
Incident playbook: SLA breach template + customer comms example
Upgrade migration notes: how to pin customers to previous model version
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: unexpected quality regression on long-context prompts. Mitigation: run extended QA on top-100 customer prompts and hold canary at 5%
Risk: higher than expected per-token cost. Mitigation: reserve a dedicated capacity burst plan and enable quantization recommendation for heavy-use customers
Risk: documentation mismatch across SDK versions. Mitigation: lock SDK release pipeline and require smoke tests before docs publish
metrics_to_track: Adoption: number of customers selecting the new model variant (daily)
Performance: p50 and p95 latency for generation streams (hosted + dedicated)
Cost: avg tokens-per-request and cost-per-1k tokens vs baseline
Quality: eval pass-rate on release prompt set and user-reported quality incidents
Reliability: error rate, downgraded responses, and retry rates
sprint_tasks_snapshot: PM: finalize blurb and publish Confluence checklist
ENG: merge catalog integration PR and deploy staging tagging job
Benchmarks: complete 10k-sample eval and upload results to Drive
Docs: update SDK quickstart and publish to docs.redwood.ai
Marketing: finalize blog draft and scheduled send time in Pardot
